solution.title: Cloud PKI Integration with Intune (Certificate Management Modernization)

products.name: Cloud PKI Integration with Intune (Certificate Management Modernization) — Commercial
products.short_description: Modernize certificate management with a cloud PKI integrated with Intune — issue certificates via SCEP/PKCS through the cloud PKI's Intune connector, deploy the trust chain, and migrate off the on-prem CA. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Modernize certificates — issue them from a cloud PKI through Intune, and retire the on-prem CA dependency

Device and user certificates are everywhere — Wi-Fi, VPN, authentication — but issuing them from an aging on-prem CA + connector chain is fragile and hard to scale. A cloud PKI with an Intune integration modernizes this: certificates are issued to Intune-managed devices through the cloud PKI's Intune connector/plugin, with the trust chain deployed and the on-prem dependency reduced or retired. This solution sets up the cloud PKI ↔ Intune integration, issues certificates via SCEP/PKCS profiles, and migrates certificate workloads off the legacy CA.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — how a cloud PKI integrates with Intune (connector/plugin, SCEP/PKCS issuance), the trust-chain model, what modernizing off an on-prem CA looks like, and the migration/coexistence approach.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Entra ID, a cloud PKI subscription with an Intune integration, the trust chain, target device groups, a pilot group, change control) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing. Cloud-PKI product specifics are deferred to the vendor's documentation.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: connect the cloud PKI to Intune, deploy the trusted root/intermediate chain, create SCEP/PKCS certificate profiles, issue to a pilot, validate certificate-backed scenarios (Wi-Fi/VPN/auth), migrate workloads off the legacy CA, then expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — certificate/connector readiness discovery, per-device certificate-issuance validation, a certificate coverage and expiry report, safe remediation of failed issuance, and a certificate-scope group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Certificates issued to Intune-managed devices from a cloud PKI — trust chain deployed, Wi-Fi/VPN/auth scenarios validated, and the on-prem CA dependency reduced or retired — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • CPKI-Discovery.ps1 — cloud PKI + Intune readiness: certificate connectors and cert profiles (Graph)
    • CPKI-Remediation.ps1 — safe remediation of failed certificate issuance (default -WhatIf)
    • CPKI-Report.ps1 — certificate coverage + expiry across managed devices (Graph)
    • CPKI-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — create the certificate-scope Entra groups (devices/users, pilot/broad)
    • CPKI-Validation.ps1 — per-device certificate issuance + trust-chain validation (local, Windows)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
